question: Does POST /v1/emails accept a `subscriber` field, as the Send transactional email example on https://buttondown.com/features/api shows (status sent and subscriber set to an email address), and does that deliver one email to that address without a send to the list?
why: The Create Email reference lists no subscriber body parameter, the OpenAPI EmailInput schema has no subscriber property and sets additionalProperties to false, and the API error-codes page says an unknown field returns a 422 with the type extra_forbidden, so the marketing example and the reference disagree. The example sits in the hidden tab panel of the page; the capture sha256:cc230749bfe97e93f11f3467389233b404f6cd73b7f57cb8643ad23a23a4a0fd holds its sample, which sets subscriber to sarah@example.com. An authenticated request from a free account would settle it; it needs a sign-up, so it is a step for the open issue labelled rq:operator.
